Об игре— About Tales of the World —

Tales of the World is a single-player RPG. Guided by its story and quests, players will embark on a hero’s journey.

With the capabilities of a new engine, we are planning to fully remake the game. (Aug 29, 2024)

Due to the loss of assets from the original project, the previous version will no longer be maintained. A new version of the game will be released in the future. (Apr 11, 2026)

The reset version V0.1 has been released. It currently includes only the prologue, intended to test playability. More content is still being developed. (Apr 15, 2026)

No multilingual support is planned at the moment; currently, only Simplified Chinese content is available.
